# neuron v0.1.1 — Windows beta

Windows 10/11 (x86_64). The installer and portable ZIP include the tray app and CLI.

The bundled updater now finds beta releases and can download assets from a private repo when `gh` is signed in. Documentation is shorter and more accurate, and the README links directly to the bug report guide and the new macro skill.

Close Synapse before launching Neuron. Autostart is off by default. Configuration stays beside the app unless `NEURON_RUN_DIR` is set.

The Windows builds are unsigned. Check `SHA256SUMS.txt` against your download; `SOURCE.txt` names the source commit. These assets were built locally and have no provenance attestation.

**Hardware tested:** Naga V2 Pro and BlackWidow Chroma V2 for device controls. BlackShark V2 with its included USB sound card, and Seiren V3 Mini were also tested; Neuron has no device-specific features for those audio devices.

**Limits:** In-game hi-res polling, scroll stage tables, and snap-tap writes remain gated pending wire captures. Onboard button remapping and debounce lack trusted opcodes. Synapse import reads plaintext exports, not encrypted cloud profiles. Macros run unsandboxed CPython. See [current status](https://github.com/worflor/neuron/blob/main/docs/STATUS.md) for the full feature ledger.

**Linux is deferred.** The app and CLI build from source, but this release has no Linux download. Live remaps, audio, gestures, and overlay work are on [codex/linux-runtime-parity](https://github.com/worflor/neuron/tree/codex/linux-runtime-parity). The overlay still needs visual work, and Linux input has not been verified on real Razer hardware. No macOS build.
